prose: A World Science Festival panel video asks whether there are problems beyond the reach of AI. The retrievable page content is YouTube's player scaffolding rather than a transcript, so the panel's arguments can't be summarized faithfully here; the question itself - which problem classes resist current AI approaches - is the live one as capability claims accelerate.
